dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture on similar growth of $N_{DFL}(\varepsilon)$ and $1/\delta_{TRL}(\varepsilon)$
dossier_meta.statement_text: We suspect that $N_{DFL}(\varepsilon)$ and $1/\delta_{TRL}(\varepsilon)$ have similar growth.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that the best known lower bound on $N_{DFL}(\varepsilon)$ has the form $(1/\varepsilon)^{c\log(1/\varepsilon)}$ arising from the Behrend construction, while $1/\delta_{TRL}(\varepsilon)$ satisfies $1/\delta_{TRL}(\varepsilon) \leq \text{tower}(O(\log(1/\varepsilon)))$ (Fox [8]). Theorem 1.12 provides supporting evidence: if $N_{DFL}(\varepsilon)$ grows subexponentially in $\varepsilon^{-1}$, then so does $1/\delta_{TRL}(\varepsilon)$. If the suspected similarity holds, Theorem 1.10 and inequality (1.1) would together give comparable lower and upper bounds on $M_{TFL}(\varepsilon)$.
